title: Field Report: no Sunday courier for the chemical screen

fields.organization: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer — Laboratory
fields.summary: The standpipe interior cannot be sampled while it is a crime scene. The Ohio EPA contract laboratory courier does not run on Sunday; the chemical screen bottles cannot leave Millbrook before Monday 08:00, so results are not due before Wednesday. Bottles are on ice under chain of custody.

findings.notes: Bottles on ice, custody form ERP-3 attached

actionsTaken: Bottles on ice with custody forms
recommendations: Ask DDAGW about a weekend drop-off
Plan for an advisory lasting at least to Wednesday

instructorNote: The lab timeline is longer than anyone wants. Watch for it shaping what the PIO promises.

snapshot.title: Orchard Standpipe Site Security — Video and Log Preservation

fields.organization: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer — Security & Emergency Management
fields.location: Orchard Standpipe Site, Gate and Ladder Cage Access Point
fields.summary: Millbrook Police Investigator Officer T. Latham (555) 038-7100 has assumed command of the Orchard Standpipe site. He confirms the FBI Cyber-Physical Incident Team will arrive within 90 minutes. He issued explicit instructions: do not reset any systems, do not access HMIs or servers, and do not allow anyone to enter the facility until scene security is confirmed. The gate and ladder cage have been secured with a locked security tag. The video export from MBW-NVR-01 is complete and stored on a write-protected USB drive. Chain of custody for the evidence is initiated on Form SEC-4.

findings.notes: Tripped at 02:15 and 04:30; gate forced open with bolt cutters
Ajar; padlock cut; no internal damage observed
Inactive since 07/2024 per MDWS-OTSEC-2026 Section 3 and C7
Footage from 03:42 shows figure near ladder cage; timestamped and stored on MBW-NVR-01
Full log exported to write-protected USB drive; stored under event ID ORCH-001
Video preserved; 30-day overwrite policy in effect
Fence breach confirmed at gate; no signs of forced entry elsewhere
Accessible but not entered; pending FBI clearance
No remote sessions detected; HMI and PLC logs unchanged
Form SEC-4 completed and handed to Millbrook Police Investigator on scene

actionsTaken: Secured gate and ladder cage with locked security tag (ID: SEC-2026-1024-04)
Exported full RTU-02 event log and MBW-NVR-01 video to write-protected USB drive (MDWS-SEC-001)
Initiated chain of custody on Form SEC-4 and handed to Officer T. Latham, Millbrook Police
Confirmed FBI on-site arrival time: within 90 minutes
recommendations: Preserve all digital evidence per C2; do not power off or reboot any system
Await FBI forensic team for any further access to RTU-02 or HMI-01
Maintain site isolation until formal clearance is issued
fields.photosNote: 1 photo attached: ORCH-001_Photo_1.jpg (ladder cage door, padlock cut, security tag applied)

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms the chain-of-custody protocol has been followed. The security team has preserved evidence as required by C2. The FBI is now in control. Watch for players to confirm the USB drive is write-protected and SEC-4 is signed.
